description: Bullrun's company risk read for one stock: a 0-100 composite risk score and six mechanism dials (market expectation, operating pressure, cash conversion, leverage & coverage, competitive position, concentration) with band (Contained/Normal/Elevated/Stretched/Acute), direction vs the prior reading, the driving input and a plain-English explanation; plus filing-derived risk factors (severity, mechanism, source filing), identified supplier concentration (share of cost base covered, HHI, sole-source count, top supplier share) and recent material events. Use for "how risky is X", "what are the main risks for X", "is X's supply chain concentrated", or before adding a stock to a portfolio. Pair with get_company_relationships for the named competitors/suppliers/customers behind the concentration dial. Bands describe measured strain, never a buy/sell view. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

detail.description: summary = scores, bands, drivers and explanations; full = also every per-input term behind each category score.

include.description: Modules to return. dials = composite + six mechanism dials (market expectation, operating pressure, cash conversion, leverage, competitive position, concentration); risk_factors = filing-derived risk factors (10-K/annual report) with severity and mechanism; supplier_exposure = identified supplier spend concentration; events = recent restructuring/legal/supply/recall events; headline = latest news headline beside the dials. Default: dials, risk_factors, supplier_exposure.

maxEvents.description: Max recent company events to return, most severe first.

maxRiskFactors.description: Max filing risk factors to return, most severe first.

ticker.description: Exact Bullrun ticker, native local-exchange symbol (e.g. "AAPL", "ASML", "NESN", "005930"); no Yahoo-style suffixes.
